concept: DynamoDB Global Tables: multi-Region active-active writes
tests: Choosing a global multi-Region DB with millisecond local reads and writes in every Region.
expected: DynamoDB Global Tables: active-active replication, low-latency read/write in every Region. Triggers: "globally distributed", "multi-Region", "single-digit millisecond reads and writes in each Region", leaderboard.
why_not: RDS Multi-AZ is single-Region; Redshift is an analytics DWH; a single ElastiCache node is neither durable nor multi-Region.
